name: Hi Express for WooCommerce
author: hiexpress

sections.description:
Hi Express for WooCommerce is the official plugin for integrating your store with Iraq’s premier fulfillment and delivery network. Connect to 46M shoppers and streamline your logistics with automated order syncing, real-time tracking, and automated status updates.

Key Features

  • Automated Order Creation: Send WooCommerce orders directly to Hi Express with one click.
  • Real-time Tracking: Display live shipment tracking timelines directly on the order edit page.
  • Webhook Integration: Automatically update WooCommerce order statuses (Processing, Completed, etc.) when they change in Hi Express.
  • Status Mapping: Fully configurable mapping between Hi Express shipment events and your WooCommerce order statuses.
  • Airwaybill Support: Automatic generation and synchronization of Airwaybill (AWB) numbers.
  • Driver Information: Sync driver names and vehicle details to your order notes for better customer service.
  • Return Cost Sync: Automatically track and log return costs and adjust order totals when applicable.

External services

This plugin relies on the Hi Express API to function effectively.

  • Service: Hi Express API
  • Usage: Create shipments, retrieve tracking information, and synchronize order statuses.
  • Data Sent: formatting Customer details (Name, Address, Phone), Order details (Order ID, Total, Items), and Store information.
  • Privacy Policy: Hi Express Privacy Policy
  • Terms of Service: Hi Express Terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the hi-express-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Hi Express Settings.
  4. Enter your API Key and configure your environment (Staging/Production) in the plugin file.
  5. Map your order statuses and register your webhook.
sections.faq:
Where do I get my API key?

You can obtain your API key from your Hi Express merchant dashboard.

Does this support Cash on Delivery (COD)?

Yes, the plugin automatically detects the COD amount and sends it to Hi Express as the collection value.

  • Implemented code-side environment configuration.
